question: Specify and statically validate a modeled CxHP8-like (SNpp45) coxa forward-limit encoder for all six legs, with tuning taken from recorded real-fly walking kinematics rather than from any simulation outcome.

basis.identity: Step A MATCH_ALL (docs/evidence/hair-plate-identity-v1/run/result.json): SNpp45 by leg nerve (T1 VProN, T2 MesoLN, T3 MetaLN) and side
basis.physiology: Nature Communications 2026 / PMC12139860: CxHP8 is tonically active at the anterior limits of coxa movement; no numeric thresholds available to us

kinematics.content: aligned untethered real-fly walking step, 45 samples at 3 ms, FlyGym joint conventions

feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Body model: coxa joints are unlimited (no jnt_range) and coxa actuators have +/-1e6 ctrlrange, so no model range can set a threshold.
Head lies along +x of the Thorax frame (unit vector x 0.9997), so +x is anatomical anterior.
Standing pose: every coxa long axis points almost straight down (forward component -0.275 to 0.009).
Kinematics file keys and per-joint min/max were listed; forward components of recorded poses were not computed.

signal.definition: f_leg = ((x_Femur - x_Coxa) / |x_Femur - x_Coxa|) . e_x(Thorax): forward component of the coxa long axis (coxa body origin to femur body origin) in the Thorax frame, from MuJoCo body positions
signal.anterior_check: Head position in the Thorax frame must have x > 0.99 of its norm, else INCONCLUSIVE

tuning.threshold: theta_leg = 90th percentile (numpy linear) of f_leg over the 45 recorded poses, computed by forward kinematics in our body with the leg's three recorded coxa angles
tuning.saturation: f_max_leg = maximum of f_leg over the recorded poses
tuning.rate_hz: 120 * clip((f - theta_leg) / (f_max_leg - theta_leg), 0, 1); same rate for every SNpp45 neuron of that leg; tonic, no adaptation
tuning.max_rate_source: 120 Hz, the existing tibia and tactile encoders' maximum (an engineering constant, not a hair-plate measurement)
tuning.delivery: MaleCNSBrain.set_external_drive Poisson rates (as existing encoders); delivery is Step C, not this step

static_checks.S1_identity: encoder neuron sets equal Step A's per-leg SNpp45 sets
static_checks.S2_tuning_defined: theta_leg < f_max_leg for all six legs
static_checks.S3_recorded_activity: fraction of recorded poses with rate > 0 is within [0.05, 0.15] per leg (definition-consistency check)
static_checks.S4_monotonic: rate is nondecreasing in f on a 201-point grid from -1 to 1 per leg
static_checks.S5_rest_pose: rest-pose (B4 initial state) f and rate reported per leg; must be finite

descriptive.D1_axis_direction: per leg, change in f when each coxa joint (Coxa, Coxa_roll, Coxa_yaw) alone moves +0.1 rad from the rest pose; reports which FlyGym coxa coordinate and sign moves the coxa forward (relevant to the unresolved motor sign problem; not a motor mapping)

acceptance.ENCODER_READY: S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5 all pass
acceptance.INCONCLUSIVE: kinematics hash, anterior check or body identity fails

interpretation_limits: Modeled transduction: threshold from one recorded walking step, maximum rate an engineering constant; not measured hair-plate tuning.
Uniform rate per leg ignores hair-by-hair recruitment.
Static validation only; no CNS or physics experiment. Middle/hind homology rests on Step A.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
